title: Signal: PyPI password stored in the publish configuration
scope: A .pypirc file that declares a PyPI password written directly into the checked-in `.pypirc`.
limitations: It matches a PyPI password written directly into the checked-in `.pypirc` in the parsed .pypirc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .pypirc that mentions a PyPI password written directly into the checked-in `.pypirc` in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
